issue_deck: Week 5 brings a 142-point losing heartbreak, a 4.5-point nail-biter, and a graveyard of wasted points left sitting on the pine.

lead_story.headline: THE 142-POINT HEARTBREAK THAT CRACKED THE RECORD BOOKS
body: malle_dips_pouches discovered the arithmetic limit of misfortune in Week 5. Pouring in an astronomical 142.92 points against The Big Gronkowski, malle_dips_pouches still walked away with a 5.94-point defeat. It is an offensive output robust enough to rank #4 among all losing scores in the historical sample of 756 recorded contests.

The architecture of the disaster extends beyond catching a 148.86-point opponent. A review of the inactive roster reveals that 10.12 points of validated lineup optimization sat unused. Had Jacory Croskey-Merritt and Brenton Strange been deployed instead of Tucker Kraft and Michael Wilson, the math reverses entirely, turning a devastating L into a 4.18-point victory.

matchup_recaps.headline: A Razor-Thin Escape in the Week's Closest Bout
matchup_recaps.body: Post Mahomes edged out ThreatLevelMidnight 110.6 to 106.1, securing a 4.5-point margin. Entering with a 9-5-0 historical head-to-head advantage, Post Mahomes managed a 91.18% lineup efficiency with 10.7 points left on the bench, while ThreatLevelMidnight recorded a 100% efficient game that still fell short.

matchup_recaps.headline: A 148-Point Explainer on How to Survive an All-Time Bad Beat
matchup_recaps.body: The Big Gronkowski survived malle_dips_pouches's historical #4 losing score by putting up a week-high 148.86 points. Even with 16.8 points left on the bench when Tony Pollard and Matthew Golden could have been started instead of CeeDee Lamb and DK Metcalf, the total of 148.86 points held off the 142.92-point onslaught.

matchup_recaps.headline: Ginger FC Secures a Win Despite an 85.35% Efficiency Mark
matchup_recaps.body: Ginger FC 🏆🏆 defeated Buttermilk Puuump 109.54 to 92.04 despite an 85.35% efficiency rate. Leaving 18.8 points on the bench—including keeping Denzel Boston and J.K. Dobbins in reserve over David Montgomery and Chris Olave—did not prevent the victory.

matchup_recaps.headline: Joe Mantegna Capitalizes on Opponent's Bench Blunders
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna defeated Patty Primetimes 145.24 to 115.2, posting a 94.1% lineup efficiency while watching Patty Primetimes strand 23.0 points on the bench.

matchup_recaps.headline: Malle ❤️ 🐸 Breaks Skid Behind 99.09% Efficiency
matchup_recaps.body: Malle ❤️ 🐸 ended a two-game skid by defeating Voldemort 119.5 to 88.26 while operating at a 99.09% lineup efficiency. Voldemort countered with a 79.9% efficiency mark and 22.2 points left in reserve.

matchup_recaps.headline: Pop Lockett Drop it Rolls to Week's Largest Margin
matchup_recaps.body: Pop Lockett Drop it secured the week's biggest blowout, defeating Uncle Rico 125.04 to 90.92 for a 34.12-point win. Building on an 8-3-0 historical edge against Uncle Rico, Pop Lockett Drop it maintained a 90.78% efficiency to move to 4-1-0 on the season.

managerial_desk.headline: THE PINE PARADE: 23 POINTS LEFT TO RUST
managerial_desk.body: Patty Primetimes registered the week's most inefficient roster management, stranding 23.00 points on the bench. By starting George Kittle and Josh Downs instead of Keon Coleman and Isaiah Likely, Patty Primetimes dropped an optimal 138.2-point ceiling to an actual 115.2-point output. Voldemort followed closely, leaving 22.2 points of optimal scoring on the bench by starting Brock Purdy and Alvin Kamara over Jayden Daniels and Kyle Pitts Sr.

luck_report.headline: THE LEDGER OF THE MISFORTUNATE AND THE FORTUITOUS
luck_report.body: malle_dips_pouches absorbed the heaviest bad beat of the week, dropping a 142.92-point game despite an 81.82% expected win rate and 9 all-play wins. Patty Primetimes also absorbed a bad beat despite a 54.55% expected win rate. Conversely, Ginger FC 🏆🏆 and Post Mahomes secured wins with expected win rates of 36.36% and 45.45% respectively.

record_book.headline: THE #4 ALL-TIME GRIEF ENTRY
record_book.body: malle_dips_pouches's 142.92-point scoring output now stands as the #4 highest losing score across 756 historical league games.

previews.body: The Big Gronkowski holds a 5-3-0 historical head-to-head record and 872.94 total points against Uncle Rico across 8 prior meetings, but projection models forecast a 105.24 to 90.69 edge for Uncle Rico.

previews.body: Voldemort holds an 8-4-0 historical record and 1316.78 points against malle_dips_pouches across 12 meetings, though the projection engine lists malle_dips_pouches with a 94.71 to 78.82 advantage.

previews.body: Joe Mantegna enters with a 7-4-0 historical edge over Post Mahomes across 11 games backed by 1180.46 points, while the projection model favors Post Mahomes with a 96.35 to 90.51 outlook.

previews.body: ThreatLevelMidnight holds a 5-4-0 margin across 9 prior meetings against Pop Lockett Drop it. The projection model pegs ThreatLevelMidnight at 116.86 and Pop Lockett Drop it at 115.44.

previews.headline: Primetimes's 8-1 Series Lead Confronts a Ginger Projection
previews.body: Patty Primetimes commands an 8-1-0 historical edge and 1037.5 points against Ginger FC 🏆🏆 across 9 prior matchups. The projection model favors Ginger FC 🏆🏆 at 97.86 to 113.82.

closing_shot: malle_dips_pouches put up 142.92 points and still lost because 10.12 points remained on the bench.
